medicine-costs.name: Medicine costs
medicine-costs.line: I skip or stretch my medicine because I can't afford it.

sources.passage: a quarter (27%) who have not filled a prescription
one in five (19%) who have cut pills in half or skipped doses of medicine because of the cost

medicine-costs.prevalence: In a recent KFF poll, 27% of U.S. adults had not filled a prescription and 19% had cut pills in half or skipped doses because of the cost.

headaches.name: Headaches
headaches.line: I lose days to migraines or bad headaches.

sources.passage: headache disorders affect approximately 40% of the population, or 3.1 billion people in 2021
14 Headache disorders 588

headaches.prevalence: Headache disorders affect about 40% of people worldwide, 3.1 billion in 2021 (WHO), and rank 14th among causes of disease burden (IHME GBD 2021).

injury.name: Injury
injury.line: I got hurt, and my body still hasn't recovered.

sources.passage: 10 Road injuries 809
19 Falls 531
By 2020, halve the number of global deaths and injuries from road traffic accidents

injury.prevalence: Road injuries rank 10th and falls 19th among global causes of disease burden (IHME Global Burden of Disease study).

body-image.name: Body image
body-image.line: I don't like how my body looks.

sources.passage: one in five (20 per cent) said they had felt "shame" because of their body image in the last year.
Just over one in eight UK adults (13 per cent) have experienced suicidal thoughts or feelings
A11 Are you able to accept your bodily appearance?

body-image.prevalence: In a UK survey, 20 per cent of adults had felt shame because of their body image in the last year, and 13 per cent had suicidal thoughts or feelings because of it (Mental Health Foundation).

weight.name: Weight
weight.line: My weight gets in the way of how I want to live.

sources.passage: The prevalence of obesity among U.S. adults 20 and over was 41.9% during 2017–March 2020.
During the same time, the prevalence of severe obesity among U.S. adults was 9.2%.

weight.prevalence: 41.9% of U.S. adults had obesity and 9.2% severe obesity in 2017–March 2020 (CDC).

fertility.name: Fertility
fertility.line: I've been trying to have a baby, and it isn't happening.

sources.passage: Estimates suggest that approximately one in every six people of reproductive age worldwide experience infertility

fertility.prevalence: About one in every six people of reproductive age worldwide experience infertility (WHO).

mobility.name: Mobility
mobility.line: I can't walk or get around as easily as I need to.
aliases: I have trouble walking or climbing stairs.

sources.passage: mobility - 12.2%
A15 How well are you able to get around?

mobility.prevalence: 12.2% of U.S. adults have a mobility disability (CDC).

daily-tasks.name: Everyday tasks
daily-tasks.line: I need help with everyday things like bathing, dressing or cooking.

sources.passage: independent living - 7.7%
self-care - 3.6%
A17 How satisfied are you with your ability to perform your daily living activities?

daily-tasks.prevalence: 7.7% of U.S. adults have an independent-living disability and 3.6% a self-care disability (CDC).

not-listened-to.name: Doctors don't listen
not-listened-to.line: I don't feel listened to or believed by my doctors.

sources.passage: A third of adults overall report at least one of several negative experiences with a health care provider

not-listened-to.prevalence: A third of U.S. adults report at least one negative experience with a health care provider, such as being ignored or blamed (KFF).

insurance-denials.name: Insurance denials
insurance-denials.line: I have to fight my insurance to cover care I need.

sources.passage: found that 18% of insured adults say they experienced denied claims in the past year.
roughly 6 in 10 insured adults experience problems when they use their insurance.

insurance-denials.prevalence: 18% of insured U.S. adults had a denied claim in the past year, and roughly 6 in 10 had problems using their insurance (KFF).

health-upkeep.name: Managing my health
health-upkeep.line: Keeping up with appointments, medicines and tests wears me out.
leads: Founder pool (hierarchy v2): treatment_burden, "looking after my health takes more effort than I can comfortably manage", "coordinating appointments and different healthcare providers is exhausting". No opened list names it.

bladder.name: Bladder control
bladder.line: I plan my day around getting to a bathroom in time.
leads: Founder pool (hierarchy v2): "bladder control problems limit my social activities / make travel difficult". No opened list names it.
